latest_complete_run.error: release publisher handoff has an invalid artifact digest or last tag

diagnosis: First GitHub-only release has last-tag empty. GitHub toJSON(needs) omits that empty job output. Builds release_outcome.reduce_results requires last-tag to be a string, so the publisher handoff fails. Complete-mode retries resume the same marked draft and fail the same way. Empty last-tag is valid for a first release; missing is not distinguished from invalid. Not a product failure and not a disabled-publish result.
